Silver Baton.description: An indestructible silver scepter that can fire energy rays.

ability.name: Silver Ray
ability.text: Golden Bat levels the Silver Baton. A beam of blinding silver light tears through {enemy}!

Red Cape.description: A high-collared cape that grants flight and invisibility.

ability.name: Vanish
ability.summary: dodge the next attack; escape is certain
ability.text: The Red Cape sweeps around Golden Bat, and he is gone. Only his laughter remains.

Swashbuckler Armor.description: Ornate Atlantean plating that grants invulnerability.

Hydroflask.description: A vessel holding the water needed to awaken the God of Justice.

ability.name: Living Water
ability.text: Golden Bat tips the Hydroflask. Water older than the ocean pours over his bones.

Kinesis Stone.description: An ancient relic granting the user powers of terrakinesis and aerokinesis.

ability.name: Gale Push
ability.text: Golden Bat thrusts out a skeletal hand. A howling gale slams into {enemy}!

Spectral Reins.description: Ethereal bindings used to control giant ancient machines.

ability.name: Bind
ability.summary: a beast or machine's next attack hits itself
ability.text: Golden Bat casts the Spectral Reins. Threads of pale light sing through the air.

Icarus Data.description: Critical data about the rogue planet's collision course.

ability.name: Analyze
ability.summary: exposes a weak point: +50% damage for the rest of the fight
ability.text: Golden Bat consults the Icarus Data. Atlantean script races across the crystal, mapping {enemy} line by line.

Botan Rice Candy.description: A classic Japanese treat with an edible wrapper. It smells sweet, like fortune and nostalgia.

Coral Salve.description: A paste of crushed red coral from Professor Mire's medical kit. Restores 20 HP.

Glowmoss.description: Bioluminescent moss that hums faintly. Golden Bat's bones drink in its light. Restores 3 Energy.

Ship Radio.description: A battered shortwave radio from Professor Mire's ship. Its dials are cracked, but Marie might coax it back to life.

Journal Page I.description: Professor Mire's handwriting: '...the Atlanteans did not worship Golden Bat. They feared him. "He is justice without mercy," reads the frieze, "and the wicked hear his laughter in their sleep."'

Journal Page II.description: Professor Mire's handwriting: '...seven relics were forged to arm the Golden Judge. Three lie in the ruins above, three sank with the city below, and the seventh, they say, "belongs to the sky."'

Journal Page III.description: Professor Mire's handwriting: '...Nazō's men are searching for the lens in the wrong place. It is not in the ruins. It is BENEATH them. Marie must never come here.'
